name: 90262 · Lynwood, CA
findings: ZIP 90262 (Lynwood) has 97 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (22%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90262 (Lynwood) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 90262 (Lynwood) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 39% of the typical level).
